Meta's Muse AI application has reached 10 million downloads in the U.S. within 40 days of its launch, making it one of only 11 apps to hit this milestone in such a timeframe.

Globally, it has recorded 10.9 million downloads since September.

Performance metrics indicate a 23% user retention rate after 14 days, compared to a 16% average for competing AI applications.
